verdict.rationale: vLLM installs as a pip/uv Python package and documents an in-process Python offline-inference interface (e.g., passing trust_remote_code=True), so it has its own Python way to call the runtime. Its OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible servers let developers use other vendors' SDKs, but those are not vLLM's own client libraries and earn no credit. missing for 10: a documented official vLLM client SDK for calling a running server, any official JavaScript/TypeScript library, client API reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript
